items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I had Clarence, and I got some guy's name, played the same beef right tenor. Christophe. Yeah, Harold Christophe.

ctx.x: Well, did he hock them or what? I don't know what he'd done to him. No, he didn't hock them.

Now, he's got a banjo in the museum right now. His wife thinks that's his banjo. That wasn't his. That's his friend of mine's banjo. He borrowed it. You see, when I got to playing regular, I had a band. I made a band of my own. Me, who I had, Henry Ravallon. I had Clarence, and I got some guy's name, played the same beef right tenor. Christophe. Yeah, Harold Christophe. Harold Christophe. And I was playing the banjo. And who was somebody else again? And then after that, I got this guy to play with me. When…
What kind of banjo did you have when you first started?
